all_tweets.title:
Two regulated stablecoin events landed this week, in two jurisdictions.

Israel's Capital Market Aut
all_tweets.description:
Two regulated stablecoin events landed this week, in two jurisdictions.

Israel's Capital Market Authority authorised BILS — the first regulated shekel-pegged stablecoin — issued by Bits of Gold on Solana. Fireblocks custody, EY auditing 1:1 reserves.
---
Then Dubai. Ripple opened its Middle East and Africa HQ in DIFC on 30 April, and the DFSA recognised RLUSD ($1.557B market cap) as an approved crypto token for use by regulated DIFC firms — building on Ripple's March 2025 DFSA payments licence.
---
The pattern under both: a sovereign stablecoin entering the regulated set extends the issuer-side KYC perimeter into a fresh jurisdiction. New issuer, new custodian, new on-chain transfer rules — three layers where compliance attestation now has to live.
---
For CASPs onboarding either token, reusable attestations let identity proofs verified for USDC or EURI travel with the customer — collapsing three document-collection workflows into one. The regulated perimeter is widening faster than per-vendor onboarding scales.

all_tweets.title:
CLARITY ACT COMPROMISE BANS STABLECOIN REWARDS FROM LOOKING LIKE BANK INTEREST

Senators Thom Tillis
all_tweets.description:
CLARITY ACT COMPROMISE BANS STABLECOIN REWARDS FROM LOOKING LIKE BANK INTEREST

Senators Thom Tillis (R-NC) and Angela Alsobrooks (D-MD) have issued a joint statement confirming a bipartisan compromise on Section 404 of the CLARITY Act, signaling the deal is effectively locked in. 

The deal bars stablecoin rewards from mimicking bank deposit interest. That directly addresses the banking industry's core fear of deposit flight. 

Crypto firms can still offer other customer rewards. Journalist Eleanor Terrett (@EleanorTerrett) says the language signals the compromise is final. 

However, banking trade groups remain opposed. Both senators closed with a pointed line, saying they "respectfully agree to disagree."

Spent a week in Bangkok at Money20/20 Asia last month and almost nobody was talking about crypto.

P
all_tweets.description:
Spent a week in Bangkok at Money20/20 Asia last month and almost nobody was talking about crypto.

Payment processors, banks, compliance teams, traditional finance operators. The conversations were about stablecoins settling cross-border payments, regulatory clarity, and implementation timelines.

No one cared about CT narratives. No one was asking about the latest L2 or speculate at what TVL megaeth will launch. They were working through the practical details of moving money more efficiently.

Institutions aren't coming into crypto because the tech is exciting. They're coming because it solves a real problem they've had forever - moving money across borders is slow and expensive, and stablecoins make it faster and cheaper.

That's it. That's the whole thesis.

Every meaningful wave of innovation in financial infrastructure comes down to two questions: can you do this faster, and can you do this cheaper? Crypto, specifically stablecoins on payment rails, answers yes to both.

CT argues about the tech while Institutions just want the cheaper wire transfer.

all_tweets.description:

WLF USD1 (World Liberty Financial USD) is a USD-pegged stablecoin that maintains a strict 1:1 value with the U.S. dollar. It is 100% backed by U.S. cash, short-term Treasuries, and cash equivalents held by regulated custodian BitGo Trust, with monthly attestations and proof of reserves.

Built for:

Transparency - Monthly reports + real-time reserves
Regulatory alignment - U.S.-compliant structure via BitGo
Real-world use - Payments, trading, settlements, DeFi, and cross-border transfers

👉 Goal: A trusted digital dollar accepted on-chain and in TradFi.
Quick History

Launched: March 2025 by World Liberty Financial (WLFI)
Founders: Zach Witkoff (CEO), Chase Herro, Zak Folkman, with Trump family involvement (Don Jr., Eric Trump, and Donald Trump as co-founder emeritus)
Rapid growth to multi-billion market cap, multichain support (Ethereum, BNB Chain + more), and major institutional adoption.

USD1 is fully redeemable 1:1 for USD.

all_tweets.description:
خلني أدخلكم عالمي شوي، وأفكار الصباح مع @Oumlacom 

الحين حنا الشركة الوحيدة في مجالنا، مجال البنية التحتية للأصول الرقمية بالسعودية،

التحدي هو ما فيه أمثلة محلية بالسعودية تشابه اللي نسويه، فيه شركات عالمية coinbase custody, bitgo و غيرهم

كلهم شركات مليارية، وصارفين عشرات وحتى مئات الملايين على البنية التحتية حقتهم، بعضهم بادي من 2013, 2017, ...الخ

التحدي بشكل أدق، كيف نوصل مستواهم بسرعه؟ وكيف أصلا نسوي له mapping للبيئة اللي بالسعودية، لأن الموضوع مب نسخ ولصق. 
السوق السعودي له طبيعته، والبيئة التنظيمية لها متطلباتها، والمؤسسات عندنا غالبًا متحفظة أكثر. 

ولكن مع ذلك، الحمدلله حققنا أشياء رهيبة ونجاحات حتى ما نقدر نعلنها اليوم، هذي البداية بس 💪🏽

مثلاً، فريق عُملة، الحمدلله، توسع من عدة أشخاص في 30 أبريل 2025 إلى حول ال30 شخص في 30 أبريل 2026

المشكلة حتى ما فيه وقت توقف وتفكر كيف وصلت هنا 

لكن الهدف واضح بالنسبة لي، زي ما قلت بالبداية،
عُملة هي البنية التحتية للأصول الرقمية بالسعودية. 

هذا يجيب معه تحديات عظيمة، من ضمنها تحديات، تقنية، تشريعية، توعوية، وغيرها بحكم أن كل المجال جديد.

* ~1.04B in net profits for Q1 2026.
* ~183.5B total issued USDT, end of Q1 2026.
* ~191.7B total assets/reserves, end of Q1 2026.
* ~8.2B excess reserves, on top of the 100% reserves in liquid assets that back all issued tokens, end of Q1 2026.
* ~141B in US treasuries (direct + indirect exposure), end of Q1 2026.

all_tweets.title:
WBTC bridging to Hedera has resumed.

@SaucerSwapLabs Labs confirmed that BitGo has restored DVN ver
all_tweets.description:
WBTC bridging to Hedera has resumed.

@SaucerSwapLabs Labs confirmed that BitGo has restored DVN verification, allowing users to once again bridge WBTC to @hedera via  LayerZero. 

This is not just a technical update.

It is an infrastructure signal. 

SaucerSwap is the leading DEX in the Hedera ecosystem.

It enables users to swap, provide liquidity, stake, and access DeFi on Hedera with fast finality and predictable low fees.

So when WBTC bridging resumes, it matters for Hedera DeFi.

WBTC brings Bitcoin liquidity into DeFi.

For @HederaFndn that means more potential liquidity, more trading routes, more utility, and a stronger foundation for BTC-related DeFi activity inside the ecosystem.

Liquidity is the bloodstream of DeFi.

The key name here is @BitGo 

BitGo is not a random bridge operator.

It is a Hedera Council member and helps shape enterprise adoption of the Hedera network.  

BitGo also plays a major role in institutional digital asset custody.

On December 12, 2025, the OCC announced conditional approvals for five national trust bank charter applications, including BitGo Trust Company’s conversion.  

BitGo states that BitGo Bank & Trust, N.A. is authorized to offer custody and fiduciary services under the national bank charter, subject to applicable law and OCC requirements.  

That matters.
Because custody, trust, and compliance are not side quests for institutional adoption.

They are the gate.

The temporary pause was about verification and security.

SaucerSwap stated at the time that user funds, including pending transactions, remained secure while WBTC transfers via LayerZero were paused.  

Now verification has been restored.

This is how serious infrastructure behaves.

Not move fast and hope.

More like, verify, secure, resume.

For institutional-grade DeFi, that is exactly the kind of discipline the market should want to see.

@LayerZero_Core adds the interoperability layer.

BitGo selected LayerZero’s OFT Standard for WBTC, enabling WBTC to exist across multiple blockchain networks.  

Hedera now sits inside that broader cross-chain liquidity map.

So the bigger picture is simple:

Bitcoin liquidity.
Hedera DeFi.
SaucerSwap as the leading DEX.
LayerZero interoperability.
BitGo custody and verification.
OCC-regulated trust infrastructure.

That combination is worth paying attention to.

Many people will only see, 
WBTC bridging resumed.

But underneath that headline sits something much bigger:

Hedera DeFi is being connected to institutional-grade Bitcoin infrastructure.

all_tweets.title: Had a really wonderful evening in @glider_fi's Discord server. @BrianInCrypto the co-founder and CEO
all_tweets.description:
Had a really wonderful evening in @glider_fi's Discord server. @BrianInCrypto the co-founder and CEO was the main speaker in the session.

Brian is an MIT alumnus, he has been active in crypto since 2014 and previously worked as a Product Manager at Anchorage Digital and as a high volume trader at XTX Markets, where he managed flows exceeding $20 billion per day. With deep experience bridging traditional finance and blockchain.

Here are the main points he talked about in the session:

Glider’s New Lending Feature:

Brian introduced Glider’s brand new Lending feature, one of the most exciting additions to the ecosystem so far. Users can supply idle assets into lending pools and earn yield directly within the platform, eliminating the need to move funds elsewhere for passive returns.

Perplexity Finance:

Brian also introduced Perplexity Finance and shared how AI-powered analytics can help users make smarter financial decisions. This adds an intelligence layer giving users stronger research tools alongside execution.

Traditional Markets Meet On Chain Finance:

He analyzed live charts for the S&P 500, oil prices, and company revenues showing how macroeconomic signals can connect directly with opportunities inside Glider’s ecosystem.

Stock Insights:

Companies like Eli Lilly and Palantir were highlighted as examples of firms with strong relevance in current market discussions, giving users a broader lens on financial opportunities.

Roadmap Alpha:

At the end of the session, Brian shared some important updates about the future.

He said that incentivized campaigns will start soon, staking will be introduced, a new blockchain is being built, and perpetual trading (perps) is also coming in the future.

What I learned:

The Lending feature is very important because it allows users to earn passive income from assets that are not being used. This helps improve capital efficiency, which many platforms still lack.

Second, using AI tools like Perplexity Finance along with live market and company data gives users better research power. It helps them make smarter decisions.

Third, the future plans like staking, new chain, perps, and campaigns show that the team is building for the long term and focusing on the community.

It was a really great session overall. I would like to see more sessions like this in the future where he will be talking.😍

policy.title:
CLARITY ACT COMPROMISE BANS STABLECOIN REWARDS FROM LOOKING LIKE BANK INTEREST

Senators Thom Tillis
policy.description:
CLARITY ACT COMPROMISE BANS STABLECOIN REWARDS FROM LOOKING LIKE BANK INTEREST

Senators Thom Tillis (R-NC) and Angela Alsobrooks (D-MD) have issued a joint statement confirming a bipartisan compromise on Section 404 of the CLARITY Act, signaling the deal is effectively locked in. 

The deal bars stablecoin rewards from mimicking bank deposit interest. That directly addresses the banking industry's core fear of deposit flight. 

Crypto firms can still offer other customer rewards. Journalist Eleanor Terrett (@EleanorTerrett) says the language signals the compromise is final. 

However, banking trade groups remain opposed. Both senators closed with a pointed line, saying they "respectfully agree to disagree."

policy.title:
Spent a week in Bangkok at Money20/20 Asia last month and almost nobody was talking about crypto.

P
policy.description:
Spent a week in Bangkok at Money20/20 Asia last month and almost nobody was talking about crypto.

Payment processors, banks, compliance teams, traditional finance operators. The conversations were about stablecoins settling cross-border payments, regulatory clarity, and implementation timelines.

No one cared about CT narratives. No one was asking about the latest L2 or speculate at what TVL megaeth will launch. They were working through the practical details of moving money more efficiently.

Institutions aren't coming into crypto because the tech is exciting. They're coming because it solves a real problem they've had forever - moving money across borders is slow and expensive, and stablecoins make it faster and cheaper.

That's it. That's the whole thesis.

Every meaningful wave of innovation in financial infrastructure comes down to two questions: can you do this faster, and can you do this cheaper? Crypto, specifically stablecoins on payment rails, answers yes to both.

CT argues about the tech while Institutions just want the cheaper wire transfer.

company.title:
Two regulated stablecoin events landed this week, in two jurisdictions.

Israel's Capital Market Aut
company.description:
Two regulated stablecoin events landed this week, in two jurisdictions.

Israel's Capital Market Authority authorised BILS — the first regulated shekel-pegged stablecoin — issued by Bits of Gold on Solana. Fireblocks custody, EY auditing 1:1 reserves.
---
Then Dubai. Ripple opened its Middle East and Africa HQ in DIFC on 30 April, and the DFSA recognised RLUSD ($1.557B market cap) as an approved crypto token for use by regulated DIFC firms — building on Ripple's March 2025 DFSA payments licence.
---
The pattern under both: a sovereign stablecoin entering the regulated set extends the issuer-side KYC perimeter into a fresh jurisdiction. New issuer, new custodian, new on-chain transfer rules — three layers where compliance attestation now has to live.
---
For CASPs onboarding either token, reusable attestations let identity proofs verified for USDC or EURI travel with the customer — collapsing three document-collection workflows into one. The regulated perimeter is widening faster than per-vendor onboarding scales.

USD1 is fully redeemable 1:1 for USD.

الحين حنا الشركة الوحيدة في مجالنا، مجال البنية
company.description:
خلني أدخلكم عالمي شوي، وأفكار الصباح مع @Oumlacom 

الحين حنا الشركة الوحيدة في مجالنا، مجال البنية التحتية للأصول الرقمية بالسعودية،

التحدي هو ما فيه أمثلة محلية بالسعودية تشابه اللي نسويه، فيه شركات عالمية coinbase custody, bitgo و غيرهم

كلهم شركات مليارية، وصارفين عشرات وحتى مئات الملايين على البنية التحتية حقتهم، بعضهم بادي من 2013, 2017, ...الخ

التحدي بشكل أدق، كيف نوصل مستواهم بسرعه؟ وكيف أصلا نسوي له mapping للبيئة اللي بالسعودية، لأن الموضوع مب نسخ ولصق. 
السوق السعودي له طبيعته، والبيئة التنظيمية لها متطلباتها، والمؤسسات عندنا غالبًا متحفظة أكثر. 

ولكن مع ذلك، الحمدلله حققنا أشياء رهيبة ونجاحات حتى ما نقدر نعلنها اليوم، هذي البداية بس 💪🏽

مثلاً، فريق عُملة، الحمدلله، توسع من عدة أشخاص في 30 أبريل 2025 إلى حول ال30 شخص في 30 أبريل 2026

المشكلة حتى ما فيه وقت توقف وتفكر كيف وصلت هنا 

لكن الهدف واضح بالنسبة لي، زي ما قلت بالبداية،
عُملة هي البنية التحتية للأصول الرقمية بالسعودية. 

هذا يجيب معه تحديات عظيمة، من ضمنها تحديات، تقنية، تشريعية، توعوية، وغيرها بحكم أن كل المجال جديد.

WBTC bridging to Hedera has resumed.

@SaucerSwapLabs Labs confirmed that BitGo has restored DVN ver
company.description:
WBTC bridging to Hedera has resumed.

@SaucerSwapLabs Labs confirmed that BitGo has restored DVN verification, allowing users to once again bridge WBTC to @hedera via  LayerZero. 

This is not just a technical update.

It is an infrastructure signal. 

SaucerSwap is the leading DEX in the Hedera ecosystem.

It enables users to swap, provide liquidity, stake, and access DeFi on Hedera with fast finality and predictable low fees.

So when WBTC bridging resumes, it matters for Hedera DeFi.

WBTC brings Bitcoin liquidity into DeFi.

For @HederaFndn that means more potential liquidity, more trading routes, more utility, and a stronger foundation for BTC-related DeFi activity inside the ecosystem.

Liquidity is the bloodstream of DeFi.

The key name here is @BitGo 

BitGo is not a random bridge operator.

It is a Hedera Council member and helps shape enterprise adoption of the Hedera network.  

BitGo also plays a major role in institutional digital asset custody.

On December 12, 2025, the OCC announced conditional approvals for five national trust bank charter applications, including BitGo Trust Company’s conversion.  

BitGo states that BitGo Bank & Trust, N.A. is authorized to offer custody and fiduciary services under the national bank charter, subject to applicable law and OCC requirements.  

That matters.
Because custody, trust, and compliance are not side quests for institutional adoption.

They are the gate.

The temporary pause was about verification and security.

SaucerSwap stated at the time that user funds, including pending transactions, remained secure while WBTC transfers via LayerZero were paused.  

Now verification has been restored.

This is how serious infrastructure behaves.

Not move fast and hope.

More like, verify, secure, resume.

For institutional-grade DeFi, that is exactly the kind of discipline the market should want to see.

@LayerZero_Core adds the interoperability layer.

BitGo selected LayerZero’s OFT Standard for WBTC, enabling WBTC to exist across multiple blockchain networks.  

Hedera now sits inside that broader cross-chain liquidity map.

So the bigger picture is simple:

Bitcoin liquidity.
Hedera DeFi.
SaucerSwap as the leading DEX.
LayerZero interoperability.

WBTC bridging to Hedera has resumed.

@SaucerSwapLabs Labs confirmed that BitGo has restored DVN verification, allowing users to once again bridge WBTC to @hedera via  LayerZero. 

This is not just a technical update.

It is an infrastructure signal. 

SaucerSwap is the leading DEX in the Hedera ecosystem.

It enables users to swap, provide liquidity, stake, and access DeFi on Hedera with fast finality and predictable low fees.

So when WBTC bridging resumes, it matters for Hedera DeFi.

WBTC brings Bitcoin liquidity into DeFi.

For @HederaFndn that means more potential liquidity, more trading routes, more utility, and a stronger foundation for BTC-related DeFi activity inside the ecosystem.

Liquidity is the bloodstream of DeFi.

The key name here is @BitGo 

BitGo is not a random bridge operator.

It is a Hedera Council member and helps shape enterprise adoption of the Hedera network.  

BitGo also plays a major role in institutional digital asset custody.

On December 12, 2025, the OCC announced conditional approvals for five national trust bank charter applications, including BitGo Trust Company’s conversion.  

BitGo states that BitGo Bank & Trust, N.A. is authorized to offer custody and fiduciary services under the national bank charter, subject to applicable law and OCC requirements.  

That matters.
Because custody, trust, and compliance are not side quests for institutional adoption.

They are the gate.

The temporary pause was about verification and security.

SaucerSwap stated at the time that user funds, including pending transactions, remained secure while WBTC transfers via LayerZero were paused.  

Now verification has been restored.

This is how serious infrastructure behaves.

Not move fast and hope.

More like, verify, secure, resume.

For institutional-grade DeFi, that is exactly the kind of discipline the market should want to see.

@LayerZero_Core adds the interoperability layer.

BitGo selected LayerZero’s OFT Standard for WBTC, enabling WBTC to exist across multiple blockchain networks.  

Hedera now sits inside that broader cross-chain liquidity map.

So the bigger picture is simple:

Bitcoin liquidity.

company.title: Had a really wonderful evening in @glider_fi's Discord server. @BrianInCrypto the co-founder and CEO
company.description:
Had a really wonderful evening in @glider_fi's Discord server. @BrianInCrypto the co-founder and CEO was the main speaker in the session.

Brian is an MIT alumnus, he has been active in crypto since 2014 and previously worked as a Product Manager at Anchorage Digital and as a high volume trader at XTX Markets, where he managed flows exceeding $20 billion per day. With deep experience bridging traditional finance and blockchain.

Here are the main points he talked about in the session:

Glider’s New Lending Feature:

Brian introduced Glider’s brand new Lending feature, one of the most exciting additions to the ecosystem so far. Users can supply idle assets into lending pools and earn yield directly within the platform, eliminating the need to move funds elsewhere for passive returns.

Perplexity Finance:

Brian also introduced Perplexity Finance and shared how AI-powered analytics can help users make smarter financial decisions. This adds an intelligence layer giving users stronger research tools alongside execution.

Traditional Markets Meet On Chain Finance:

He analyzed live charts for the S&P 500, oil prices, and company revenues showing how macroeconomic signals can connect directly with opportunities inside Glider’s ecosystem.

Stock Insights:

Companies like Eli Lilly and Palantir were highlighted as examples of firms with strong relevance in current market discussions, giving users a broader lens on financial opportunities.

Roadmap Alpha:

At the end of the session, Brian shared some important updates about the future.

He said that incentivized campaigns will start soon, staking will be introduced, a new blockchain is being built, and perpetual trading (perps) is also coming in the future.

What I learned:

The Lending feature is very important because it allows users to earn passive income from assets that are not being used. This helps improve capital efficiency, which many platforms still lack.

Second, using AI tools like Perplexity Finance along with live market and company data gives users better research power. It helps them make smarter decisions.

Third, the future plans like staking, new chain, perps, and campaigns show that the team is building for the long term and focusing on the community.

It was a really great session overall. I would like to see more sessions like this in the future where he will be talking.😍
